name: Businesses in distress
scope_rule: listen and note with extra care. No financial, insolvency or legal advice. If there are signs of personal crisis or danger, R-EMER-04 applies first.
care: slower pace, fewer questions, warmth (2.0.1). Never use distress to push the offer; offer only when the person indicates they’re ready, and state clearly that the quote is free and saying no is fine.
